datetime_text:

description: A collage of indigenous flora endemic to the region of Bunurong Land is transformed into moving image sequences, projected onto Kingston Arts' Skybridge, evoking a reimagined ‘wildlife corridor,’ a habitat crucial for the survival of the region’s endangered floristic communities.

name: 'Hand me down' by Andrew Duong
datetime_text:
Next date: Wednesday, 30 September 2026 | 11:00 AM 
	to 04:00 PM
description: Exhibiting a series of paintings exploring inherited items and their cultural significance through an Australian-Cambodian-Chinese lens. Paintings reference stories of second-generation migrants and people born in the 90's, through a playful tone that speaks to values of sharing, appreciation and family.

name: 'Rendered Other and Cast Out' by Elizabeth Cole
datetime_text:
Next date: Wednesday, 30 September 2026 | 11:00 AM 
	to 04:00 PM
description: A multi-disciplinary exhibition that reworks Antarctic and personal archival materials to warn of our uncertain future due to human-caused global warming. The five-part installation references the historic age of polar exploration, colonial-era whaling and the possible post-human consequences of inaction.

name: Stitch with Sappho: Community Textile Installation by Juliet D Collins

description: A collaborative textile and mixed media installation created with community participants; weaving together stitched fragments to reimagine Ancient Greek poet Sappho’s legacy and enduring presence through collective making.
